description: This file contains utility functions for handling Windows paths, including detection and skipping of DOS drive prefixes, offset calculation for the first path component, and comparison functions for path strings.

methods.name: int win32_has_dos_drive_prefix(const char * path)
methods.description: Checks if the given path starts with a DOS drive letter prefix, returning the length of the prefix if present.

methods.name: int win32_skip_dos_drive_prefix(char ** path)
methods.description: Skips the DOS drive prefix in the given path if present, updating the path pointer.

methods.name: int win32_offset_1st_component(const char * path)
methods.description: Calculates the offset to the first component of the path, handling UNC paths and drive prefixes.

methods.name: int win32_fspathncmp(const char * a,const char * b,size_t count)
methods.description: Compares two file system paths case-insensitively or case-sensitively, up to a specified length.

methods.name: int win32_fspathcmp(const char * a,const char * b)
methods.description: Performs a full comparison of two file system paths.

ctags.name: win32_fspathncmp
ctags.pattern: /^int win32_fspathncmp(const char *a, const char *b, size_t count)$/
